name: Yamaha V Star 1100
engine: 1063 cc air-cooled SOHC V-twin, two carbs, shaft drive
intro: A popular big cruiser. Owners report many starter clutch failures. Yamaha sells a repair kit for it.

add.title: Check the starter clutch
add.instructions: Listen for kickback or grinding on start. If the starter spins without turning the engine, fit Yamaha's starter clutch repair kit.
add.reason: Owners report widespread starter clutch failures on these bikes.

F: Learning the right starting routine helps prevent most starter clutch trouble.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Starter clutch kit
known.what: Yamaha sells a starter clutch repair kit, part 99999-03908.
